entries.source: Sector maps use regional overview contours, with an optional A–B terrain profile.

drafts.zu: Amamephu eSector asebenzisa imigqa yokuphakama yesifunda, enenketho yephrofayili yomhlaba A–B.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa Sector di sebedisa mela ya bophahamo ya kakaretso ya sebaka, ka kgetho ya profaele ya naha A–B.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya Sector yi tirhisa mitila ya ku tlakuka ya ndhawu hi ku angarhela, hi nhlawulo wa xivumbeko xa misava A–B.
drafts.ve: Mapa a Sector a shumisa mitalo ya vhuimo ha nṱha ya dzingu nga u angaredza, na khetho ya phurofaili ya mavu A–B.
